data.exact_reserve_text: An overall deterioration of GBP 3.7 million on prior years' provisions was experienced during the year. Deteriorations of GBP 11.5 million on third party liability, GBP 4.3 million on energy and GBP 3.4 million on pecuniary loss were largely offset by an improvement of GBP 17.5 million on reinsurance acceptances.

prior_year_events.impact_description: 2017 year of account heavily impacted with losses from Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, contributing to prior year deterioration.
Increases in medium sized losses from the California wildfires required strengthening of reserves in the casualty account.
Medium sized losses from the MGM shooting in the US led to casualty reserve strengthening.
Creep in the size of the Typhoon Jebi loss in 2018 increased gross losses and impacted the syndicate on a gross basis.

prior_year_events.event_name: Macy's warehouse fire (US) and Brazilian warehouse fire
prior_year_events.impact_description: Large man-made losses from warehouse fires in the US and Brazil emanated from the cargo account and were significant man-made losses for the syndicate.

named_events.loss_description: The largest natural catastrophe loss incurred by the syndicate was in respect of Typhoon Hagibis.
Syndicate was impacted by Typhoons Hagibis and Faxai out of Japan.
Extensive flooding in Townsville, Australia impacted the syndicate.
Hurricane Dorian greatly threatened the US but veered east massively reducing potential damage; the syndicate benefited from reinsurance.
Major bushfires affecting large parts of Australia continued into 2020 and impacted the market; syndicate benefited from reinsurance programme.
Significant creep within the market in the size of the Typhoon Jebi loss that occurred in 2018 which also impacted Syndicate 2121 on a gross basis.
Largest natural catastrophe losses arising from the California wildfires impacted prior years.
Hawaiian volcanic eruptions in 2018 contributed to increased losses.
Hurricane Michael in 2018 impacted the syndicate.
Hurricane Florence had lesser impact but was noted among impacting events.
One of the largest man-made losses from fires at a Macy's warehouse in the US; emanated from the cargo account.
Large man-made loss from a Brazilian warehouse; emanated from the cargo account.

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2019 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding opening position (1 Jan 2019) was GBP 411.463m. During 2019 there was a net prioryear deterioration (strengthening) of GBP 3.7m on prior years' provisions driven by adverse development particularly in third party liability (GBP 11.5m), energy (GBP 4.3m) and pecuniary loss (GBP 3.4m), partly offset by an improvement on reinsurance acceptances (GBP 17.5m). The movements reflect adverse claim developments and some large manmade and natural catastrophe losses from prior years (e.g. 2017 hurricanes, 2018 wildfires and Jebi) together with recoveries from reinsurance programmes.
raw_causal_phrases: An overall deterioration of GBP 3.7 million on prior years' provisions was experienced during the year.

Deteriorations of GBP 11.5 million on third party liability, GBP 4.3 million on energy and GBP 3.4 million on pecuniary loss were largely offset by an improvement of GBP 17.5 million on reinsurance acceptances.

The 2017 year also required a strengthening of the reserves within the casualty account, in line with the market, following increased medium sized losses from the California wildfires and the MGM shooting in the US.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Statement of Financial Position (Technical provisions, Claims outstanding) prior-year column. Prior-year development sourced from the "Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding" note (explicit gross deterioration GBP 3.7m). A gross claims development triangle is present (note 22) and is reported below; triangle values are presented in the accounts in thousands. Some table rows are triangular (shorter for more recent underwriting years) and have been padded with nulls for development periods not yet reached. Mapping of 'Pecuniary loss' -> 'Professional Lines' and 'Reinsurance acceptances' -> 'Treaty' is an interpretative mapping for standard LOB reporting.
